svg.aria-label: NFC installation diagram for My Airport Taxi NI 120 by 80 mm plate
svg.text: Installation diagram — My Airport Taxi NI NFC plate
Finished size 120 × 80 mm landscape · ~5 mm rounded corners · NTAG213 25 mm sticker · installer sheet only

g.text: NFC centre behind TAP · QR printed on right
NFC sticker centre: 25.0 mm from left · 50.0 mm from top
Orientation: landscape — logo top-left, TAP left, SCAN/QR right
Rounded corners: ≈ 5.0 mm radius (confirm die-cut with printer)
Adhesive: thin automotive tape on left + right rear margins (avoid covering NFC)
Write NDEF URI record (not plain text): https://www.myairporttaxini.co.uk/tap
Apps: NFC Tools / TagWriter · write once · lock after verify · test through finished PVC + on headrest
No metallic backing, foil or metallic laminate — NFC must pass through non-metallic PVC.
